caption:
🗣"Modern AI was built on one simple idea: machines can learn."

Ilya Sutskever says that in the early 2000s, computers couldn't truly learn, and many weren't even sure artificial learning was possible.

"He believed neural networks offered the best long-term path because they could learn from data, improve automatically, and scale with increasingly powerful parallel computers."

"Back then, models had only dozens or hundreds of neurons, a million parameters was considered huge, and researchers trained them on CPUs using MATLAB."
